$comment: Selector registry for split-expenses — the ONE place brittle UI strings live. Flows reference @keys, never raw copy. text = Maestro regex (full-match against visible text OR a11y label); testID preferred when an anchor churns. Anchors target the seeded 'Lisbon trip' group (src/qa/fixtures.ts).

first-group.note: the seeded QA group card. Wrapped with .* because the card merges name+balance into one a11y label ('Lisbon trip, you're owed ...'); Maestro full-matches the regex, so bare 'Lisbon trip' never matches the card.

add-expense.note: the detail-screen FAB (a11y 'Add expense'); also the editor's save Button label, so it's the waypoint both for opening the editor and for confirming we're back on detail.

amount-input.note: the hero amount TextInput (a11y label 'Amount'). Tap to focus before typing.

added-expense.note: OUTCOME anchor — the $42 expense added in-flow (amount only, no seeded expense is $42.00). assertNot before the add, assert after = the core add action actually landed on both platforms. Wrapped in .* because iOS merges the expense row's children into one a11y label ('General, Alex paid · split 4 ways · Today, $42.00') and Maestro full-matches the regex — a bare '\$42\.00' never matches the merged label (Android exposes the amount as its own node, so it passed there). Same .* convention as @first-group.

desc-label.note: static form label inside the AddEditExpense ScrollView (keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled'). Tapped to dismiss the keyboard cross-platform before the 'editor' screenshot — Maestro's hideKeyboard is unreliable on iOS (custom numeric input has no standard dismiss action).
